verdict.rationale: Shortwave is an AI-powered email client that processes email contents, so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a setting, policy, or guarantee that keeps user data out of AI model training. The docs only say the AI 'learns your unique voice and style from the emails you send,' which describes personalization, not a training opt-out. Community comments raise general privacy concerns but say nothing about training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
